newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money stable around 3.05 percent.
newsitem.headline: German call money stable around 3.05 percent.

text.p: German overnight call money rates were stable around 3.05 percent on Friday, despite a decline in the amount of funds credit institutions held at the Bundesbank.
Traders said the banking system still enjoyed good liquidity and that they did not expect any substantial change in rates at least until Tuesday following a holiday on Monday.
"There is no interest rate speculation," one trader said. "It is definitely quiet, prices are relatively stable around 3.05 percent and have not done anything."
Credit institutions held 40.9 billion marks with the Bundesbank on Thursday, down from 43.2 billion marks the day before. The average for the month now stands at 40.9 billion marks.
Banks borrowed 200 million marks from the emergency Lombard lending rate.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average stood at 3.08867 on Friday compared with 3.08333 percent on Thursday.
